content:
nina-sales: Heads up 70% through the ACME POC setup. Customer hit a truncation issue during demo prep  their HTML+images context got truncated. Demo tomorrow, need a workaround asap.

luis-se: Can you paste what they're sending? rough size?

nina-sales: They sent a single JSON with `document_html` (full page ~250KB) and `screenshots` array with 12 base64 PNGs (each ~800KB). Total payload 10.4MB. They use our hosted infer endpoint over straight POST. Response is 413.

luis-se: 413 = NGN/proxy body limit. Options: 1) split into multiple requests and stitch server-side, 2) presigned upload + context_url, 3) enable `Content-Encoding: gzip` if client can compress. Which can they do quickly?

sam-customer: We can do presigned URL flow but need instructions. Also want to ensure EU-only storage and that tokens from fetched content won't be billed to our card during POC.

lara-ops: (cc @tara-ops) For presign I can generate a short-lived PUT URL that writes to our internal transient blobstore (not S3) and set region eu-west-1. It will create an audit event.

tara-ops: Done. Created presign id `ps-20260321-zz`. URL (redacted) sent to sales. TTL 30m, private.

luis-se: Recommend they upload gzipped NDJSON where each line is {"role":"doc","text":"..."}, then call infer with `context_url` + `context_type: ndjson-gz`. Our server will stream-decompress and tokenize. That reduces tokenization spikes.

nina-sales: I'll send step-by-step. Also customer asked about billing: will you waive charges?

sec-bot: Security alert: ACME requested IP allowlisting. They will only accept fetches from EU datacenter IPs. Confirmed presign uploader is in eu-west-1 and fetch will originate from eu pool.

lara-ops: For billing, slack thread: @prithvi approved 500k token promo for acme-poc. Marked in account ledger.

sam-customer: Uploaded successfully and called infer with pointer. Response now 200. Thanks all.

luis-se: Nice. Follow-up: downstream they might want to preserve original binary attachments in audit logs. We can optionally store a checksum and delete blobs after tokenization. Noted for next steps.

nina-sales: Closing this thread, will open a doc for the presign workflow. :sparkles:
